label: R5.3 STEP3 Decoder Verify
info: Checks /data/converter_tool only. It may chmod the uploaded decoder executable and run a DIN70121 decode smoke test. No charging-control writes.

name: Upload converter_tool to Persistent Data first, then press RUN
info: Expected location: /data/converter_tool. This flow does not install packages or touch charging logic.

name: RUN decoder verify + DIN smoke test

command: echo '---R5.3 DECODER FILE---'; if [ ! -f /data/converter_tool ]; then echo 'STATUS=MISSING'; echo 'Upload the ARMv7/musl converter_tool to vSECC Persistent Data first.'; exit 0; fi; ls -l /data/converter_tool; echo '---CHMOD---'; chmod 755 /data/converter_tool 2>&1 && echo 'CHMOD=OK' || echo 'CHMOD=FAIL'; echo '---SHA256---'; (sha256sum /data/converter_tool 2>/dev/null || true); echo '---DIN70121 SMOKE TEST---'; OUT=$(/data/converter_tool decode 809a021050908c0c0c0c0c51514002808142807c0c0c0000 urn:din:70121:2012:MsgDef 2>&1); RC=$?; echo "EXIT_CODE=$RC"; echo "$OUT"; if [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'STATUS=READY_DIN'; else echo 'STATUS=EXEC_OR_DECODE_FAILED'; fi; true
name: Verify /data/converter_tool
